4) NDAs — Claire: a few of your execs asked for a quick NDA add-on for the private roundtable portion. We sent a one-page mutual NDA last night; please confirm signatures.

5) Expense code & invoice timing — Marissa: would like the expected invoice date and expense code for customers who will be reimbursing.

Attachments: supper_table_roster_v3.xlsx (please edit directly in the sheet link), edens_menu_allergens.pdf

Appreciate quick replies — if anything is a hard blocker call my cell.

Sharing a short legal note and a redline. I reviewed the venue addendum Marco sent — overall fine but we asked for one minor language change to the liability paragraph related to allergen disclosure and guest medical responsibilities. This is not a commercial term, just a protective clause for attendees.

Key suggested language (summary): "Host and caterer will make commercially reasonable efforts to identify potential allergens in menu items and will provide separate preparation where feasible; guests with known severe allergies must notify organizer in advance and are responsible for personal precautions."

I attached redline_clause_allergens.docx with the exact sentence to drop into Section 4. Venue legal already said they'd accept a one-sentence insertion — Sophie, can you confirm in the DocuSign room?

Also: please confirm whether the venue needs the DocuSign room to show proof of insurance before signing or after; we can expedite our broker if required.
